breakpoints.$description: Screen widths for the Figma 03 Token modes. Not defined in Figma; agreed with the design owner. Desktop is the default mode; Tablet applies below `desktop`, Mobile below `tablet`. <html data-device="desktop|tablet|mobile"> forces a mode regardless of width.
